    Get Available SITUAS Tables

    get_situas_tables.Rd

    Retrieves territorial unit data from the SITUAS (Sistema Informativo Territoriale delle Unità Amministrative e Statistiche) API. The function implements intelligent caching to minimize API calls and enable offline use. Cached data is stored locally and can be refreshed as needed.

    This is a convenience wrapper around situas_get_report_data that provides caching functionality and defaults to retrieving the municipalities list (report ID 61).

    get_situas_tables(
  pfun = 61,
  date = Sys.Date(),
  date_end = NULL,
  force_refresh = FALSE,
  max_age_hours = 24,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    pfun

    Integer. Report ID to retrieve. Defaults to 61 (municipalities list). See list_available_reports for all available reports.

    date

    Date, POSIXct, or character string. The reference date for the report. For DATA type reports, this is the single date parameter. For PERIODO/ATTUALIZZAZIONE type reports, this is the start date. Defaults to current date.

    date_end

    Date, POSIXct, or character string. End date for PERIODO and ATTUALIZZAZIONE type reports. Required for these report types, ignored for DATA type reports. Default is NULL.

    force_refresh

    Logical. If TRUE, bypass cache and download fresh data from the API. If FALSE (default), use cached data if valid.

    max_age_hours

    Numeric. Maximum age of cache in hours before automatic refresh. Default is 24 hours. Ignored if force_refresh = TRUE.

    verbose

    Logical. If TRUE (default), print informative messages about cache status and download progress.

    Value

    A data.table containing the requested report data. The structure depends on the report ID requested. For the default municipalities report (ID 61), it includes columns such as:

    COD_RIP

    Geographic partition code

    COD_REG

    Region code

    COD_UTS

    Province/UTS code

    PRO_COM

    Municipality code (numeric)

    PRO_COM_T

    Municipality code (text)

    COMUNE

    Municipality name

    DEN_REG

    Region name

    DEN_UTS

    Province/UTS name

    SIGLA_AUTOMOBILISTICA

    Car registration code

    COD_CATASTO

    Cadastral code

    Details

    Get Available SITUAS Tables

    Downloads the list of available territorial units from the SITUAS API. This function uses caching to enable offline use and reduce unnecessary API calls. By default, it retrieves the municipalities list (report ID 61).

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get current municipalities list using cache if available
municipalities <- get_situas_tables()

# Force refresh from API
municipalities <- get_situas_tables(force_refresh = TRUE)

# Get municipalities as of a specific date
municipalities_2020 <- get_situas_tables(date = as.Date("2020-01-01"))

# Get provinces instead of municipalities
provinces <- get_situas_tables(pfun = 64)

# Get municipality changes over a period (PERIODO type report)
changes <- get_situas_tables(
  pfun = 99,
  date = as.Date("2020-01-01"),
  date_end = as.Date("2025-01-01")
)

# Use cached data up to 48 hours old
municipalities <- get_situas_tables(max_age_hours = 48)

# Suppress messages
municipalities <- get_situas_tables(verbose = FALSE)
} # }
